description: Normalize DelveTown like and liked notification reasons into a stable like event instead of unknown. Persist the actor, notification identity, target URI or reason subject, target CID when available, and occurrence time. Treat an incoming like as a social signal, not as a direct request and not as a reason to publish a reply. Acceptance: repeated scans create one durable event; the event reaches a terminal local state; actor memory records the observed interaction once; reply and mention priority is unchanged; tests cover supported raw reasons, missing optional fields, duplicate delivery, and an unknown reason.
title: Recognize incoming like notifications
